description: Partial containment for a documented HTTP exposure.
affected_versions: GitLab CE/EE 7.0 before 18.11.13; 19.0 before 19.0.10; 19.1 before 19.1.9; 19.2 before 19.2.9; 19.3 before 19.3.6; 19.4 before 19.4.3; 19.5 before 19.5.1. Custom Ruby installations also require patched Ruby.
coverage: Denies .org blob-view paths and ALL blob preview paths. Preview containment includes non-.org URLs because the caller can select the Org renderer with file_path in the request.
limitations: Does not inspect repository content or detect the compiler overflow. Automatic README rendering, other markup renderers/routes, and background processing are outside this guard. Upgrade GitLab and, for custom builds, Ruby per the vendor advisory. Direct-origin access and alternate upstream path decoding remain outside this guard. Synthetic matcher tests are not a vulnerable-product exploit reproduction. Apply vendor fixes.
false_positive_risk: Disables legitimate Org-mode file viewing and every blob editor preview, including Markdown previews. Ordinary Markdown blob reads and raw-file downloads remain allowed by this guard.
